workflow.head.title: Current workflow
workflow.head.repository: How work in {{repository}} moves, read from its rules as they stand at each gate.
workflow.head.unregistered: The registry does not hold it, so it is read as in no workspace: the `{{workspace}}` workspace's rules reach it.
workflow.head.workspace: How work moves in each repository of {{workspace}} that sets no rules of its own, read from the workspace's rules as they stand at each gate.
workflow.versionTip: A digest of what is drawn here: it changes when a rule does, so two pages with one version follow one workflow.
workflow.twin.repository: In a terminal: `daoris driver workflow show --repository {{repository}}`
workflow.twin.workspace: In a terminal: `daoris driver workflow show --workspace {{workspace}}`
workflow.part.none: Your part: none. Nothing here waits for a press of yours.
workflow.part.reviewed: you look at it in `{{environment}}` and say it is reviewed
workflow.part.reviewedAnywhere: you look at it and say it is reviewed
workflow.part.merge: you merge its pull request on the platform
workflow.holds.says: Before the work starts, {{plugins}} may hold it.
workflow.step.unknown: A step this page has no words for: `{{kind}}`
workflow.set.work: Its quests here, step by step as the chain has them; a done that departs from your words or lacks its evidence waits for your yes.
workflow.set.standing: Your standing answer, handed to each session here: “{{says}}”
workflow.set.opinion.both: Read before it lands and before each next step
workflow.set.opinion.required: required: with no reading, the work waits for you
workflow.set.opinion.noRecheck: commits that answer it not read again
workflow.set.look: Shown to you in `{{environment}}` before it lands; it waits until you say it is reviewed or skip the review.
workflow.set.lookAnywhere: Shown to you before it lands; it waits until you say it is reviewed or skip the review.
workflow.set.landing.automatic: Accepted automatically once its quest is done.
workflow.set.landing.accept: Waits for you to accept it.
workflow.set.landing.plugin: `{{plugin}}` pushes it and opens a pull request.
workflow.set.landing.push: No plugin pushes it: the branch is for you to push.
workflow.set.landing.tidy: Its tree and branch go once it lands.
workflow.set.pullRequest: Opened by `{{plugin}}` once the work lands; you merge it on the platform.
workflow.source.always: Always part of the work here.
workflow.runtimeTip.built: Daoris runs this step whole today.
workflow.runtimeTip.partial: Daoris runs part of this step today; what it does not is said under it.
workflow.runtimeTip.declared: The rule is set and kept, and nothing acts on it yet.
workflow.limit.opinion-partial: Work here lands only once another agent's reading of it is settled, or you go on without one by `daoris-driver opinion`; the review does not draw it yet, and no task chooses its own reviewer yet.
workflow.limit.look-partial: The landing waits until you say it is reviewed or skip the review, and a set-up step's build is shown in Daoris's browser from its session's end until then; no set-up step is composed for you yet, and nothing runs a process of its own for one.
workflow.limit.plugin-unready: Its plugin cannot land work on this machine now: it is not installed, is switched off, contributes nothing, or speaks on no `work/land` point. `daoris plugin list` says which.
workflow.limit.pull-request-unread: Its plugin answers no `work/state`, so Daoris never reads whether the pull request was merged or abandoned.
workflow.limit.pull-request-at-clean-up: Its state is asked of its plugin only when branches are cleaned up, never while someone waits on it.
workflow.edge.reviewed: then once you say it is reviewed
workflow.edge.merge: then once you merge it on the platform
workflow.repositories.title: Repositories here
workflow.repositories.body: A repository that sets a rule of its own follows its own Current workflow: a rule it sets replaces the workspace's whole.
workflow.repositories.none: No repository is in this workspace yet.
workflow.repositories.unread: The registry was not read, so which repositories here set their own rules is not known.
